title: Web need: export a collection for the DAW from the curation views
description:
## Intent

Describe what the web app would need; the web/docs session designs it.

## The need

- Wherever collections are shown (the curation loop's keep flow and a collection's page): "Export for the DAW", producing the folder the CLI writes (a zip: numbered clip files and the drum rack).
- Source of the bytes: `apricity serve` over the local library (e.g. `GET /export/collection?name=...`) or the wasm engine; as with kits and clip folders, the files reference audio on this machine, so cloud mode must say so or include audio (owner decision from M0).

## Verification

Done when the web session has accepted the need in its own issue (comment with its id).

## Release

No product commit here.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task in this epic.
